links.text:
Today, we are officially launching @WonderingApp  backed by @ycombinator

It’s Duolingo for anything — break down any complex topics, from LLMs to Analytic Philosophy into structured path of short lessons.

But it's 10x better than the Duolingo format. Every lesson comes with interactive diagrams, podcasts, and real-world applications, with a thoughtful tutor always ready to help you dive deeper.

And it’s all personalized to what you already know and how difficult you want it to be!

Wondering is the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply.

Give Wondering a try here: https://wondering.app

links.title: Wondering - Learn What You Thought You Couldn't
links.description: Wondering is the curious alternative to doomscrolling. Learn something new every day in 3-minute lessons you can watch, listen to, or read, with streaks and spaced repetition.
